name: [Mulmiyac] for 3D Motion Sickness
detailed_description:
Let me introduce the world’s FIRST and BEST overlay utility to prevent 3D motion sickness!

My ex-girlfriend — who just so happens to be my wife now — used to suffer from terrible 3D motion sickness.

I couldn’t share the games I’d loved all my life with her.

That’s when I knew I had to do something.

So I built this utility — for her. And now, for all of you.

Don’t be a fool and lose the love of your life over something as minor as 3D motion sickness.

This program might slightly cover your screen…

But it just might show you what true happiness looks like!

1. Overlay

  • Overlay on/off (hotkey registration possible)

  • 3 shapes - Flag, Square, Triangle

  • 4 aspect ratios - 4 : 3, 16 : 9, 16 : 10, 21 : 9

  • 5 sizes - Extra Small, Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large

  • 2 split screens - Vertical left, Horizontal top (hotkey registration possible)

  • 4 colors - Red, Green, Yellow, Custom (hotkey registration possible)

  • Opacity slider (0~100%)

2. Crosshair

  • Crosshair on/off (hotkey registration possible)

  • 3 shapes - Circle, Cross, Dot

  • 4 aspect ratios - 4 : 3, 16 : 9, 16 : 10, 21 : 9

  • 5 sizes - Extra Small, Small, Medium, Large, Extra Large

  • 2 split screens - Vertical left, Horizontal top (hotkey registration possible)

  • 4 colors - Red, Green, Yellow, Custom (hotkey registration possible)

  • Opacity slider (0~100%)

3. Clock

  • Clock on/off (hotkey registration possible)

  • 3 time formats - HH:mm, HH:mm:ss, h:mm am/pm

  • Font settings

  • Color settings

  • Position adjustment - Directly specify X, Y coordinates or mouse dragging

  • Opacity slider (0~100%)

4. Hotkeys

  • 6 toggle hotkeys - Mulmiyac, Overlay, Crosshair, Clock, Split screen (Ctrl, Alt, Shift available)

  • 4 color change hotkeys - Red, Green, Yellow, Custom (Ctrl, Alt, Shift available)

5. Options

  • Save/load profiles - Overlay, Crosshair, Clock (hotkeys are not saved by profile)

  • Options to auto-run on Windows startup

  • Start minimized to tray when first run Options

  • Option to automatically save settings when program is closed

  • Show confirmation message before program is closed

  • UI scale selection - Auto (OS), 100%, 125%, 150%, 175%, 200%

  • Language selection - 18 languages

6. Notes

  • Recommended to run the game in borderless windowed mode

  • Recommended to start with the largest size

  • Recommended to register the Mulmiyac on/off hotkey before use

  • Settings and profiles can be saved to the Steam Cloud

  • May conflict with anti-cheat programs
